scope.description: Read-only bounded closeout audit of every unchecked P1, P3 and P4 TODO checklist item against current plan, source, tests and retained receipts; no network, model calls, job restarts or repository changes. Dispositions assess full requirement, not just pilot or schema.
scope.note: Source and evidence hashes capture bytes read; receipts are historical claims, not independently rerun experiments. Existing task state remains authoritative.

items.requirement: Review schema examples against all pilot cases before implementing import/apply logic.
items.limits: Normalized examples and import/promotion already exist; there is no evidenced all-case review before implementation. Earlier unresolved gaps are historical, not proof of current unresolved status in every case.
items.concrete_next_action: Review each section 11 case against schema examples and current source-backed dispositions; document timing honestly and fix representational gaps before further import/apply expansion.

items.requirement: Bridge legacy archives to bc-store without losing original hashes, URLs or access classification.
items.limits: TODO P0 records 3,204 verified-body versions imported and 3,443 listed-path gaps, including 119 failed acquisitions without a body hash; original manifest lines preserve access flags privately but full classification and resolution are not proven.
items.concrete_next_action: Reconcile remaining path gaps and access classifications against retained stores and migration receipts; retain original metadata and do not invent missing bodies.

items.requirement: Parse payloads and preserve PDF pages/OCR provenance; detect empty/challenge/login payloads.
items.limits: Registered OCR and visual page/image proofs exist for selected sources; no evidence here establishes comprehensive page/OCR metadata and systematic empty, challenge and login detection for all payloads.
items.concrete_next_action: Audit parser and acquisition outcomes by payload type; persist page/OCR provenance and classify empty/challenge/login responses as failures, then cover them with behavioral fixtures.

items.requirement: Adapt bc-evidence full-document extraction to electoral/legal candidate schemas.
items.limits: Field-specific transport supports elections, measures, provisions and reported results; restriction/event and vote-category adapters, multi-document calibration and substantive acceptance remain open. Peru proposal is one document.
items.concrete_next_action: Extend typed adapters to restrictions, events and source categories; evaluate against reviewed election and legal document cohorts without auto-acceptance.

items.requirement: Record all chunk coverage, extraction ceilings, failures and resumable status.

evidence_paths.support: Library behavior and required adapter controls

items.limits: The wrapper records status for its managed runs; evidence does not show complete accounting for all extraction cohorts. Text coverage is not page/OCR completeness and library cell/claim ceilings remain material.
items.concrete_next_action: Inventory every extraction run and reconcile expected/attempted/successful/failed/omitted chunks, cell and output ceilings, retries and durable resume status.

items.requirement: Preserve exact quotes, offsets, date/value support and raw-versus-text hashes.
items.limits: Exact spans and hashes are checked for selected candidates; location or a date occurring in the document does not prove date/value support, question identity or page coverage across the corpus.
items.concrete_next_action: Require scoped human verification of each date, number and unit against versioned text/page evidence; reconcile raw and derived hashes across all accepted assertions.

items.requirement: Build review packets for identity, wording, vote totals, polarity, bindingness and legal effect separately.
items.limits: Field-specific review and individual visual proofs exist for real batches; no demonstrated complete packet workflow across all six dimensions and all cases, particularly legal effect.
items.concrete_next_action: Create an explicit per-case matrix of independently reviewed identity, wording, counts, polarity, bindingness and legal effect, with unresolved decisions and source authority.

items.requirement: Group syndication/common upstream result feeds before assessing independent support.
items.limits: The plan requires grouping; the inspected sources do not establish a general feed/syndication grouping implementation or systematic independence assessment. Some case reviews identify shared lineage.
items.concrete_next_action: Add source-lineage/feed grouping to packets and require reviewers to assess independence at the claim level.

items.requirement: Add contradiction/support alerts without using model/NLI confidence as legal acceptance.

evidence_paths.support: section 7.2 NLI alert is a review lead

items.limits: Conflicting candidate values are flagged within extraction groups; this does not demonstrate cross-source support/contradiction alerts or adjudication across the review corpus.
items.concrete_next_action: Add cross-source, claim-scoped support and conflict leads linked to evidence and human disposition; never use model confidence as acceptance.

items.requirement: Require reviewed candidates for instrument/entity/event merges; protect distinct acts and questions.
items.limits: Ballot publication gates require record and field reviews; this does not establish reviewed candidate gates for every instrument/entity/event merge or all legacy apply paths.
items.concrete_next_action: Trace every merge/apply route and require identity and field-scoped reviewed evidence, including explicit distinct-act/question safeguards and regression cases.

items.requirement: Extend decision schemas with record fingerprints, scope, supersession and evidence claim references.
items.limits: Scope, claim IDs and supersession exist in decisions; record and previous fingerprints are enforced in a separate promotion review plan. Full decision-schema and all apply-path coverage is not established.
items.concrete_next_action: Specify and enforce target revision/fingerprint and before/after field changes alongside scoped evidence and supersession for every decision/apply path.

items.requirement: Obtain Bloomington's original township placement/qualification disposition and boundary reference; obtain Joliet's original referral/advisory authority and clarify its source accounting before completing those publication reviews (`illinois-remaining-ballot-review/`).

evidence_paths.support: Bloomington; Joliet Township; Verification and scope

items.limits: Existing recovery distinguishes township electorate and city actor and records Joliet five-ballot accounting difference; original placement/boundary and referral/authority evidence and accounting remain open per task state.
items.concrete_next_action: In a separately authorized evidence recovery, obtain original Bloomington disposition and boundary and Joliet referral/authority and accounting explanation; update scoped reviews only after verification.

items.requirement: Verify electorate/qualification and policy direction for the additional Madison-report wind/solar zoning-control question; reconcile it beyond the frozen v3 seed set without treating it as a development ban or silently changing census counts (`illinois-township-ballot-review/additional-leads.json`).
items.limits: Source-qualified wording and counts are retained; electorate and qualification remain unresolved and local-control support does not determine development direction. No canonical identity or frozen denominator change.
items.concrete_next_action: Verify electorate, qualification and authority, check duplicates and independently assess direction; reconcile as an explicitly outside-freeze lead.

items.requirement: Complete broader promotion/recovery calibration and the remaining ballot identity/fact reviews; the initial Eliot batch does not close P3.
items.limits: Current receipt identifies 49 scoped published of 56 frozen groups, seven pending and one additional publication; publication is not complete identity, legal-force or calibration acceptance.
items.concrete_next_action: Finish the seven pending groups and all scoped unresolved facts, then evaluate recovery and promotion calibration across representative source and document types.

items.requirement: Extend evidence archive/publication gates to new records and source payload types.

evidence_paths.support: verify PDF, original PNG and JPEG evidence

items.limits: Existing gates and image support cover selected expanded publications; coverage of every new record, ZIP member, OCR derivation and additional payload type is not demonstrated.
items.concrete_next_action: Inventory source/payload types and publication paths, extend fail-closed proof and archive checks, and test changed/missing bodies and derivation lineage.

items.requirement: Add behavioral regression checks from plan section 11 (initial subset includes offline publication/receipt drift, historical identity baselines and portable-pointer checks; full gate coverage pending).
items.limits: Meaningful tests cover several listed behaviors, but no evidence establishes the complete section 11 matrix or a clean restore/rebuild for the full release.
items.concrete_next_action: Map every section 11 behavior to a meaningful test or missing case; implement gaps and run the complete offline gate including clean restore/rebuild.

items.requirement: Freeze a source-backed pilot and holdout set before prompt tuning.
items.limits: Source-backed pilot material and prior prompt calibration exist; no evidence of a pre-tuning frozen, source-backed pilot plus independent holdout. Timing cannot be retroactively satisfied.
items.concrete_next_action: Freeze a newly dated independent holdout and tuning history before any further tuning; document the historical sequencing limitation.

items.requirement: Review Peru, Wells, Bloomington, Piqua, Grove City, Harwood, Wilmington and El Dorado.

evidence_paths.support: Peru, Wells, Piqua, Grove City and Wilmington gaps
Piqua; Grove City; Wilmington provisional review

items.limits: Substantial case-specific reviews exist, with unresolved facts; these files do not establish complete source-backed review of all eight named cases against the pilot specification.
items.concrete_next_action: Build a case-by-case evidence and review matrix for all eight, identify missing official evidence and preserve unresolved dispositions.

items.requirement: Include earlier/December elections, failed qualification, changed results, mixed polarity and portal failure cases.
items.limits: Individual result supersession, polarity and portal failures are represented in reviews or tests; no frozen pilot matrix demonstrates each specified edge case including failed qualification and December.
items.concrete_next_action: Select and freeze source-backed cases for each edge, explicitly labeling synthetic cases where real examples are unavailable and keeping election dates distinct.

items.requirement: Include a council-only adoption/extension and predecessor-pause/replacement-ban history.

evidence_paths.support: Piqua predecessor not established; Grove City possible prior instrument

items.limits: Candidate predecessor links are not evidence of replacement; no complete frozen pilot chain is demonstrated by the inspected case material.
items.concrete_next_action: Select and review a council-only adoption/extension and an independently evidenced predecessor pause/replacement chain; retain missing links unresolved.

items.requirement: Measure discovery recall, false exclusions, primary-source recovery and identity/quote/date/unit accuracy.
items.limits: One-document candidate and located-quote counts do not measure cohort recall, false exclusions, source recovery or identity/date/unit accuracy against a reviewed reference set.
items.concrete_next_action: Define a frozen reviewed denominator, sampling and scoring protocol, then report every required metric with denominators and uncertainties.

items.requirement: Report reviewer disagreement, unresolved facts, extraction completeness and spend per review-ready record.

evidence_paths.support: estimated cost; chunk and candidate results

items.limits: Individual receipts expose costs, gaps and extraction results; no complete pilot-level reviewer disagreement or cost per review-ready record, including unpriced calls, is evidenced.
items.concrete_next_action: Record independent reviewer decisions and disagreements, completeness by document/page/chunk, unresolved facts and fully scoped spend per review-ready record, with unpriced spend explicit.

items.requirement: Set and assess documented quality thresholds; resolve silent high-impact errors before scaling.

evidence_paths.support: section 11 zero silent high-impact errors and thresholds

items.limits: The plan states a quality principle and the Peru run exposed and withheld a polarity error; documented pre-scale numeric/operational thresholds and full assessment are not evidenced.
items.concrete_next_action: Set decision thresholds before further evaluation, assess against frozen holdout, adjudicate high-impact errors and document go/no-go and remaining unknowns.

items.requirement: Present exact batch scope, call count, model/effort and budget for authorization before bulk execution.

evidence_paths.support: model, effort, call caps and dollar allocations
execution limit incident and unknown pricing

items.limits: A bounded Peru batch has recorded settings and caps; an earlier Ohio run exceeded authorized search limits. Neither proves exact scope and authorization for any new bulk execution.
items.concrete_next_action: Before any new bulk execution, present exact dataset and exclusions, provider calls, model/effort, retry policy and total/per-stage budget for explicit authorization.

priority_actions.action: Freeze independent pilot and holdout and map every required case and behavioral gate; record prior tuning chronology.
priority_actions.reuse: Existing expanded schemas, normalized pilot, case packets and section 11 tests.

priority_actions.action: Resolve archive mapping, page/OCR and source-type gaps before asserting evidence coverage.
priority_actions.reuse: Legacy bridge, registered derivations, evidence audit and visual verification.

priority_actions.action: Complete typed extraction, durable coverage, scoped support/conflict and identity/decision gates; assemble field-separated packets.
priority_actions.reuse: bc-evidence extract_document, resumable wrapper, domain candidates, identity registry and promotion review gate.

priority_actions.action: Complete remaining source and fact reviews, including Bloomington, Joliet and the additional Madison lead; preserve unresolved outcomes.
priority_actions.reuse: Existing retained reviews, publication receipts and frozen-census correspondence.

priority_actions.action: Run and report frozen pilot metrics, disagreement, costs and full behavioral regression matrix; assess predeclared thresholds.
priority_actions.reuse: Existing offline tests, extraction receipts, source hashes and review packets.

priority_actions.action: Prepare exact new bulk batch scope, model/effort, call ceilings and budget for explicit authorization before execution.
priority_actions.reuse: Existing durable reservation/settlement controls and prior receipts; do not restart completed jobs.
